prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone planetary building-layer sprite, square transparent PNG, approximately 1024 x 1024.
Purpose: reusable architecture above a SEPARATE biome ground layer. Produce BUILDING ONLY, not a diorama. Genuine zero-alpha transparency around the building; preserve translucent soft shadow. No baked soil, gravel apron, moss, grass, rocks around the site, concrete base tile, raised platform, roads, path, border or landscape. Small integral ramps/steps/support feet belonging to the structure are allowed.
Style: the approved new Boreal/Temperate structures, grounded near-future frontier engineering. Soft semi-realistic environmental 3D rendering, matte weathered steel, subdued grey/slate/forest-green or family-specific cream panels, restrained amber/cyan service lights. Large readable forms, no ink outlines, no cel shading, plastic gloss, extreme contrast, excessive greebles or neon. No text, logos, Authority branding, numerals, UI, people, vehicles or spacecraft.
Camera and lighting: elevated front-left three-quarter view about 55 degrees above the ground plane; more roof than wall, mild perspective; front and right walls visible. Soft upper-left daylight, neutral/cool fill and semi-transparent soft lower-right cast/contact shadow attached to the feet.
Framing/alignment: complete compact structure centered in a square. Building width about 65–70% of canvas, with ample transparent margin including around antennas. Keep the ground footprint centred at approximately x=50%, y=65%; its near/front foot reaches y≈82%, and its far/rear foot y≈45%. This is a reusable stable site anchor, not a floating base. Never crop. Keep a similar physical site footprint through upgrades; add height and machinery, not a sprawling campus.
Output exactly one structure, no tier lineup/contact sheet.
Input image 1 is this family's new Tier I building. Generate its Tier 3 UPGRADE: preserve the recognizable architecture, palette, camera and compact site footprint, but clearly add the capability specified below. Do not simply repeat Tier I. Keep background fully transparent and do not add terrain.
Subject: COMPOSITE WORKS — TIER 3 of 6.
Family identity: Low ribbed industrial press hall with two tidy stacks of dark composite panels and roof ventilation. Muted grey-green with clean industrial massing.
This tier specifically: raised press core and material feed tower.
Tier family progression for context (do NOT draw a lineup): 1: one low press hall; 2: reinforced roof and second press housing; 3: raised press core and material feed tower; 4: two-level lamination plant with compact curing chambers; 5: dense vertical composite curing and press equipment; 6: advanced stepped materials plant with prominent central high-pressure press.
Output: exactly the requested tier alone, genuine transparent PNG.
